processing_summary.summary: Processed the complete bridge input: 900 conservatively preselected flattened comments/replies from 1,830 raw items. The supplied set still contained heavy praise, attendance/year-checking, promotion, social chat, emoji-only, pure-timestamp, and unrelated-request noise. Useful Chemistry signals were clustered and ranked; comment-derived Chemistry truth remains unverified for CEE review.
